scope: Fictional installed-package feedback acceptance; no live/private input or source-preservation authority.

coverage.subject: Synthetic identifier validation
coverage.disposition: Supported synthetic identifiers pass privacy validation; this does not waive sensitive-name/content checks or validate the absent private snapshot.

coverage.subject: Distinctness and primary-key evidence
coverage.disposition: Overflow remains lower-bound evidence and cannot nominate a primary key; reprofile older artifacts.

coverage.subject: Numeric storage versus sensitivity
coverage.disposition: Conservative positive sensitivity remains. Reviewed numeric-measure declarations and their separate installed feedback regressions are recorded in the release evidence; no majority-based declassification.

coverage.subject: Categorical metadata and repeated keys
coverage.disposition: Bounded synthetic categories and generated repeated-key domains are supported; no source identifier pool is copied.

coverage.subject: Source enum retention
coverage.disposition: Intentional source-free default. The original golden source-enum assertion stays red on both packages; explicit reviewed local categories are separately tested.

coverage.subject: Sensitivity-name override
coverage.disposition: Intentional safety boundary; notes and declarations cannot override positive evidence.

coverage.subject: Timestamp and temporal routing
coverage.disposition: Supported offsets/bounds and disclosed missing-bound fallback are tested. Monthly-category inference remains deferred.

coverage.subject: Repeated-key cardinality
coverage.disposition: Generated repeated-key pools retain bounded distinct domains; observed output membership can be smaller in short/null-heavy samples.

coverage.subject: Distinct key roles and declared FK
coverage.disposition: Independent key domains and declared parent membership are asserted; no source mapping or arbitrary relationship inference is implied.

coverage.subject: Supported temporal extrema
coverage.disposition: Fictional typed bounds and explicit unknown/fallback behavior pass. The missing private pair and its source period remain unverified.

coverage.subject: Safe backend diagnostics
coverage.disposition: Typed diagnostics and value-free failures are tested with fictional drivers; no live reachability or raw exception-text parsing.

coverage.subject: Source names and sensitive fields
coverage.disposition: Intentional conservative policy; source-name preservation requires the separate reviewed transformation contract and local receipt.

coverage.subject: Relationships and orphan utility
coverage.disposition: Declared links and offline bounded hypotheses are tested. Source orphan-rate fidelity and absent private pair remain unverified.

coverage.subject: Conformance versus utility
coverage.disposition: Conformance assertions do not establish statistical utility. Current utility/hypothesis delivery and its installed regressions are linked from release evidence; no invented client score.

coverage.subject: Local-category preflight and limits
coverage.disposition: Scopes and existing bounded preservation contract are tested; no global cap increase or source-value logging.

coverage.subject: SQL shape and rejection
coverage.disposition: Supported shapes and fixed recovery diagnostics pass; JOIN/CTE expansion remains unsupported.

coverage.subject: Bounded aggregate work
coverage.disposition: Fictional query-count/schema-drift/batch regressions distinguish 1.6.0 and candidate. No temporary writes or live latency/scan-byte claim.

coverage.subject: SELECT expression dependencies
coverage.disposition: Unsupported automatic expression inference rejects. Owner-excluded internal SQL formula transfer is not silently implemented.

coverage.subject: Publication, overwrite and path identity
coverage.disposition: Five content/exit/preservation cases plus deterministic atime/path-swap guards pass. Original 40-process probe is separately diagnostic, not universal crash/race proof.

coverage.subject: Doctor retention and repeatability
coverage.disposition: Structured failures and missing extras pass after native-library discovery is configured. Twenty real fresh CLI doctor runs per package all exit zero; no remote service tested.

coverage.subject: Trino authentication
coverage.disposition: Fictional six-method propagation/redaction is tested. Tentative external 1.6.0 plus server username/password does not establish historical application configuration or explain 401.

coverage.subject: Boolean SQL predicates
coverage.disposition: AND/OR and forbidden-function controls pass without widening allowlists or resource budgets.

coverage.subject: Exact decimals
coverage.disposition: Declared exact DECIMAL paths and typed outputs are tested; no float-to-exact recovery or preservation exemption.

coverage.subject: Physical Parquet types
coverage.disposition: Declared valid-mode schema/readback passes. Original diagnostic overwrites its file pointer with negative output, so its final round-trip is not a valid-mode regression.

coverage.subject: Mode/ratio and artifact parity
coverage.disposition: Spec/profile/CSV routing, effective settings, deterministic replay and intentional invalid exit 1 pass. Old probe rejects nonzero ratios with edge/load by contract and mislabels exit 1 as failure.

coverage.subject: Parquet metadata honesty
coverage.disposition: Unknown statistics remain unknown and bounded supported distinctness is measured. No absent private Parquet or unknown null ratio is certified safe.

harness_corrections: Initial clean PATH omitted /opt/homebrew/bin: installed psycopg could not discover native libpq via pg_config, so doctor stopped before Trino capability. Both versions behaved identically; preserve initial outcome and rerun only affected checks with dependency discovery restored.
First conditional-formula follow-up omitted examples/business_rules/conditional_eav.json. Copy the exact reviewed fictional fixture and rerun all 33 conditional cases; no application package changes.
Copied test fixtures resolve their legacy src-relative subprocess path through an explicit symlink to that arm’s installed site-packages. No checkout source is imported.

Original scripts execute unchanged in fresh temporary roots, with selected environment bin first on PATH, no credentials/provider configuration, capture_output and 120/300-second outer timeouts. Their subprocesses lack internal timeouts; all completed normally.
Raw outputs stay local; this ledger records test IDs, statuses, hashes and explicit dispositions only.
unverified: Private snapshot/pair inputs and original private SQL source
Live database latency, scan bytes, statistical utility and orphan-rate fidelity
Fresh final-public 1M x100 configured transformation capacity
Source-row EAV pivot/unpivot and any new source-preservation consent

probe_trino_gate_ladder.py.disposition: Unchanged supplied script cannot compile on supported Python 3.11; private query source is also absent. Do not execute its monkeypatched fixed arm or supply a real server. Unpatched maintained SQL controls supply fictional acceptance.

probe_fix_ab.py.disposition: Diagnostic wrapper for product-monkeypatched fixed arm; excluded from acceptance. Unpatched original publication script plus deterministic/content-asserting maintained tests are used instead.

probe_fix_runner.py.disposition: Production publication monkeypatch is diagnostic only and not executed as acceptance. Installed payloads match public wheels byte-for-byte.

case_id_policy: Keep module/function names; replace parameter payloads with case-NNN, numbered by lexicographic original ID within each function across the selected baseline/candidate/follow-up cohort. Exact fixture hashes bind reconstruction; no parameter values or source-value hashes are published.
